## Requirements: Complete App Sessions action parity after Web Sidebar #2851

### Context / verified post-implementation review

- [#2851](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/issues/2851) shipped its **Web-only** Session-first sidebar via [PR #2866](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/2866), merged to `staging` at `2479f95fb66847108884519d2d69a9c83ba0bb6d`. The parent explicitly preserves the independent App `Sessions ← Terminal → Workspace` spatial navigation, so its six accepted Web SCs do not prove App action parity. Do **not reopen** or invalidate its legitimate Web acceptance.
- At inspected staging `b52d57cce4a740cc1c96367d50333894c8d688a5`, `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppSessionsSurface.tsx` → `SessionsListRegion` forwards only `onConfigure` and `onKill` to `SessionList`. `AppSessionsSurface` itself does not destructure/forward `onViewDetails` or `onEditDetails`, even though `WorkspaceRegion` supplies those callbacks in `sidebarProps`.
- Shared `web/src/product/session/patterns/SessionItem.tsx` builds menu items **conditionally** from callbacks: App therefore sees **Attach settings / Kill session**, not the four entries Web now has. App already has a single overflow trigger; it does **not** need Web's sidebar, rail, or column collapse.
- Shared `SessionRowActionsMenu` explicitly attaches its close-on-scroll listener only to `[data-testid="sidebar"] [data-slot="scroll-area-viewport"]`. App rows instead live under `[data-testid="app-sessions-list"]`; the App scroll owner is not covered by that explicit listener. Treat actual popup persistence/positioning as a **review risk to reproduce**, not a proven runtime bug without browser evidence.
- [#2851 SC-04 browser Case](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/2479f95fb66847108884519d2d69a9c83ba0bb6d/e2e/acceptance/cases/2851/SC-04/verify.spec.js) asserts the App spatial root/no Web drawer, but does **not** open an App Session row menu or inspect its contents. Existing Pass is not App menu-parity evidence.

### Scope / intended App design

Keep the App's established **Sessions ← Terminal → Workspace** layers, App header, search, grouped history, create action, and touch-safe navigation (see `docs/design/interaction/app.md`, #1050). This is an **App Sessions interaction completion**, not a port of Web's 246px sidebar or full-tuck geometry.

Within the App Sessions list, the existing row-tail `···` should expose the same four task-level actions already approved for Web:

1. **Session details** — inspect runtime identity and user metadata for the targeted Session, without selecting/attaching a different active Session.
2. **Edit details** — edit display alias (Title), Description and Tags through existing `SessionDetails`/`SessionMetadataSection`/Agent-owned metadata logic; clear alias falls back to immutable tmux name; maintain validation, revision/conflict and offline semantics. Do not create a duplicate metadata editor/API.
3. **Attach settings** — enter the existing configure-intent `AttachDialog` without implicitly attaching.
4. **Kill session** — visually separated destructive item; existing `KillConfirmDialog` requires typing the immutable tmux Session name rather than the display title.

Keep a single touch-safe (at least 44px) menu control and anchored overlay in the App Sessions layer; no full-list replacement action screen. Preserve the active Terminal mount/attachment while opening details or settings, and return to the correct App layer. Ensure menu placement/dismissal and focus restoration work when scrolling the **App-owned list**, not only the Web Sidebar.

### Implementation ownership

- `web/src/app/experiences/app/AppSessionsSurface.tsx`: thread the existing `onViewDetails` and `onEditDetails` callbacks into `SessionsListRegion` → shared `SessionList`; no new domain state.
- `web/src/app/WorkspaceRegion.tsx` / `web/src/app/Shell.tsx`: preserve current details dialog target and configure/kill ownership. Reuse existing `SessionDetailsDialog`, metadata hooks and `ShellDialogs`.
- `web/src/product/session/patterns/SessionItem.tsx`: resolve list-scroll dismissal against the owning scroll viewport for **both experiences**, not one global `sidebar` query; check portal placement/safe areas and experience-specific touch behavior.
- `docs/design/interaction/app.md` and `docs/design/design-system/patterns/session-item.md`: record the App action-entry contract and its separation from Web composition.
- E2E: extend the existing `e2e/tests/browser/sidebar-session-first.spec.ts` + App visual contract fixtures rather than duplicating the entire Web feature test suite.

### Prototype

- **Decision:** Required — App's four-action dropdown, details editor entry and dismissal/back-to-work need to be reviewed at native App viewport before production sign-off.
- **Question:** Does the existing App Sessions layer present the shared four actions clearly and preserve Terminal/work context without importing Web's sidebar/overlay hierarchy?
- **Scenario:** 390×844 and 375×812 App Sessions → nonselected Session `···` → view details → close → edit title/description/tags → configure → attempt/cancel typed-name Kill → scroll/dropdown dismissal → back to Terminal.
- **Status:** Interactive App-specific prototype authored and committed to shared `prototype` branch at `9b58e491f1dc03a26e05cea5c6cdf8a7121ae815` with 375×812, 390×844, 430×932 CSS-pixel App previews, four-item row menu, details/edit/configure/typed-name kill flows, offline/revision conflict/empty states, mock Terminal/Workspace navigation, simplified touch-swipe return between spatial layers, and in-page UI design inspector. GitHub source/static checks performed; **public Pages manifest/SHA and Chromium product-visual parity not yet verified**. Do not count the mock as a production Acceptance Pass.
- **Direct HTML preview candidate (publication pending verification):** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/app-session-actions-2875/index.html
- **Visual UI specification on the same page:** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/app-session-actions-2875/index.html#ui-spec
- **Immutable prototype source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/9b58e491f1dc03a26e05cea5c6cdf8a7121ae815/app-session-actions-2875/index.html
- **Scenario, fidelity and verification limits:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/9b58e491f1dc03a26e05cea5c6cdf8a7121ae815/app-session-actions-2875/README.md
- **Detailed UI metrics/ownership:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/9b58e491f1dc03a26e05cea5c6cdf8a7121ae815/app-session-actions-2875/UI-SPEC.md
- **Gallery source:** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/blob/9b58e491f1dc03a26e05cea5c6cdf8a7121ae815/index.html
- **Web precedent only:** [#2851 prototype](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/prototype/sidebar-session-first-2851) does not replace or prove this App flow.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 At App 390×844 and 375×812, each Session row exposes one touch-safe `···` anchored menu with **all four** named actions; selecting/opening the menu does not change the active Session or unmount Terminal.
- [ ] SC-02 Details and Edit details target the chosen Session without selection side effects; title/description/tags edits use existing metadata ownership, maintain tmux identity, show unavailable Agent/revision conflicts truthfully and return to App Sessions without losing context.
- [ ] SC-03 Attach settings and Kill launch existing dialogs from App; Kill remains unavailable until the exact immutable tmux name is typed. Menu dismisses on outside click/Escape/**App list scroll**, restores sensible focus, stays reachable within narrow viewport/safe area and never replaces the list.
- [ ] SC-04 App retains its spatial Sessions/Terminal/Workspace navigation, search/grouping/new-session affordance and responsive touch floor; no Web Sidebar/rail/collapse controls appear. An App-specific 1:1 interactive prototype with visible design annotations is published/reviewable and linked before visual acceptance.

### SC → scenario and evidence

- **SC-01..SC-03: SCN-02 Web/App interaction** — approved Chromium + Playwright Case against deterministic real App fixture at 390×844 and 375×812 with pointer, keyboard and emulated touch. Inspect role/menuitems, exact target Session, continuity of Terminal mounting, metadata editor, dialog affordances, App scroll owner, focus after dismiss and screenshot/geometry. Existing #2851 Web evidence is a regression reference only.
- **SC-04: SCN-02 App visual/navigation** — source-aligned browser Case verifies spatial layer and App viewport; **SCN-08 design-artifact support** via immutable prototype source/Pages manifest and in-page visual inspection. The authoritative SC proof is still executed App behavior, not mock HTML.
- Current trusted `Acceptance / Cases` lane has demonstrated exact merged-staging-SHA Case evidence for #2851; PR Case Smoke may be used for early checking, but only authenticated source-aligned results can record Pass here. No full E2E or production rollout is required for this focused App interaction parity.

## Product alignment
- [x] Session identity/work comes before infrastructure (#2851, #1050)
- [x] Progressive disclosure: one `···` menu, no permanent destructive toolbar
- [x] Preserve independent App spatial navigation and same canonical metadata/attach/kill owners
- [ ] Validate App-specific visual/touch fidelity with approved prototype and browser Case
